name: Mandarin Oriental, Taipei
positioning: Luxury city hotel in Taipei's Songshan district with a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant, a spa and a heated outdoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a Michelin-starred Cantonese dinner at their hotel
Families or friends wanting connecting rooms or suites
Guests who want a spa and a heated outdoor pool in the city

facts.text: Mandarin Oriental, Taipei is located in Taipei's Songshan district on Dunhua North Road.
The hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Nanjing Fuxing Station and Taipei Arena Station.
Taipei Songshan Airport is approximately 2 km from the hotel.
Café Un Deux Trois serves international cuisine in a relaxed, contemporary setting.
The Jade Lounge serves afternoon tea.
M.O. Bar is a cocktail destination in a sophisticated setting.
The hotel has a heated outdoor swimming pool.
The Oriental Lounge, for Club guests, is on the sixth floor.

highlights.text: Ya Ge has been awarded one Michelin star by the MICHELIN Guide Taipei, Taichung, Tainan & Kaohsiung in 2026.
Ya Ge is a Cantonese restaurant.
Bencotto is a MICHELIN Guide-selected Italian restaurant.
Club access includes daily breakfast and afternoon tea.

considerations.text: The minimum age required to access the spa, fitness and wellness facilities is 16 years.
Smart attire is recommended at the hotel's dining venues.
Guests under the age of 18 are not permitted to enter M.O. Bar.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
